artifacts.summary: 7-phase, 12-hour plan to delete the single-task engine, rewrite skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md as the four-move loop at <=20,000 B, build the batched AskUserQuestion/.decisions.json path, and retarget the coupled test/lint surface.

memory_candidates.content: When a skill rewrite deletes prose that tests scrape, sequence the work as: (1) relocate surviving narration into docs FIRST as an additive, disjoint phase, (2) delete the dead region bottom-up in one atomic-batch commit so earlier line numbers never drift, (3) rewrite, (4) retarget tests LAST. Ship any new script-side READER before the lead-side WRITER that feeds it, so the writer has an already-tested target and the schema is fixed once. This ordering keeps every wave-1 phase file-disjoint and makes each phase independently revertible.
